backend/main.mo: Defines chess data types and basic move‑validation helpers plus initial board setup stub, forming core backend logic.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a no‑op migration function transferring GameState unchanged from old to new actor.
feature_evidence.json: Feature‑evidence metadata listing files, components, and test IDs for deployment and sharing validation.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing major frontend files and their purposes in the app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind styles defining light/dark color variables and base UI theming.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell mounting the React app root and loading main.tsx.
frontend/PUBLISHING.md: Checklist describing prerequisites and clean build steps for deploying the app on the Internet Computer.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with three routes and wraps the app in theme and toast providers.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Simple footer showing attribution with a heart icon and caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Header with navigation buttons and a Share dropdown providing WhatsApp and clipboard link sharing.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Page layout wrapper including header, routed content, and footer.
Text input and send button component handling message entry and submit behavior.
frontend/src/features/chat/ChatMessageLi: Scrollable list rendering user and assistant messages with avatars and auto‑scroll.
frontend/src/features/chat/ChatView.tsx: Full chat interface managing messages, rule‑assistant calls, and navigation to learning examples.
frontend/src/features/hosting/HostingVie: Renders hosting information explaining IC canister hosting and displays the app's current URL.
frontend/src/features/learning/Chessboar: Displays a chessboard grid with Unicode pieces and highlights squares involved in the last move.
Defines chess learning examples with step-by-step board positions and descriptions.
frontend/src/features/learning/LearningV: Provides an interface to select chess examples, navigate steps, and view corresponding board positions.
frontend/src/features/learning/MoveStepp: Renders step navigation controls and a clickable move list for example walkthroughs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching chess rules and en passant explanations from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useRulesAssistant.ts: Matches user questions to predefined rules topics and enriches answers using backend rule data when available.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and sets CSS variables for light/dark chess‑themed color palettes plus global background, text, and border styles.
frontend/src/lib/rulesTopics.ts: Provides a list of chess rule topics with keywords and detailed preset answers for the rules engine, including castling, en passant, and other core concepts.
frontend/src/lib/share.ts: Implements utilities to share the app URL via WhatsApp and copy it to the clipboard with SSR‑safe checks and fallbacks.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors mapped to CSS variables, extended fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the project state, features, requirements, and issues for the Shriram Chess Assistant app including chat rules engine and sharing features.
